raw_segments.text: Well, old chap, said Joe, then abide by your words.
If he's always right, which in general he's more likely wrong, he's right when he says
Supposing ever you kept any little matter to yourself, when you was a little child,
you kept it mostly because you knowed as J.
Gardery's power to part you and tickler in sunders were not fully equal to his inclinations.
Therefore, think no more of it as betwixt too such, and do not let us pass remarks upon
Biddy Jiv herself a deal, oh, trouble with me afore I left, for I am almost awful dull,
as I should view it in this light, and viewing it in this light as I should so put it.
Both of which, said Joe, quite charmed with his logical arrangement, being done, now this
to you a true friend, say, namely, you mustn't go overdoing on it, but you must have your
supper and your wine and water, and you must be put betwixt the sheets.
